custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure bulk mode is off: no dark bar shows on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154755-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154755-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.
  • There is no checkbox column and no checkbox in the header row, so no part can be ticked.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A: its Part Number field holds part A's part number.
  • Nothing is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The window closes without changes.

Step 4:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 5:

  • Part B is listed, with no checkbox column.

Step 6:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 7:

  • The window closes without changes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-N2: “Outside the mode there is no checkbox column, so no part can be ticked from the default list.”
  • Key Decisions: “Bulk status change is a mode. A row click on the Inventory list opens the part. Bulk status uses the same pattern as Cycle count: the user turns the mode on from the actions menu, checkboxes appear, search and filtering keep working, and the X on the bulk bar leaves the mode.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
